description: This file defines the `IterateSectionWidget` class, which is part of a widget rendering framework for a web application. It manages iteration over a list of data, rendering sections of a user interface dynamically, with support for pagination, and appears to be part of the Apache OFBiz framework's widget system.

classes.name: IterateSectionWidget
classes.description: A widget class that iterates over a collection of items, rendering specified sections for each item, with support for pagination, within the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: IterateSectionWidget
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget based on its XML element, extracting attributes like list name, entry name, key name, pagination settings, and child sections.

methods.name: getSectionList
methods.description: Returns the list of section components to be rendered for each item.

methods.name: renderWidgetString
methods.description: Main rendering method that iterates over the data collection and renders each section; handles pagination logic.

methods.name: getPaginateTarget
methods.description: Returns the target service or URL for pagination links.

methods.name: getPaginate
methods.description: Determines whether pagination is enabled based on configurations and context.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns the configured size of each page/viewport.

methods.name: renderNextPrev
methods.description: Generates HTML links for navigating to previous and next pages in paginated data sets.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor, following the Visitor pattern for processing widget elements.

methods.name: getListNameExdr
methods.description: Accessor for the list name expression used to retrieve the data list from context.

methods.name: getEntryNameExdr
methods.description: Accessor for the entry name expression used during iteration.

methods.name: getKeyNameExdr
methods.description: Accessor for the key name expression used during iteration.
